description: UI test class for the Topic screen in an Android app, verifying loading states, topic display, and news list interactions.

classes.name: TopicScreenTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the UI behavior of the Topic screen in different states.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, retrieves the loading string from resources.

methods.name: niaLoadingWheel_whenScreenIsLoading_showLoading
methods.description: Verifies that the loading indicator is shown when the screen is in loading state.

methods.name: topicTitle_whenTopicIsSuccess_isShown
methods.description: Checks that the topic name and description are displayed when the topic loads successfully.

methods.name: news_whenTopicIsLoading_isNotShown
methods.description: Ensures that news content is not shown when the topic is still loading.

methods.name: news_whenSuccessAndTopicIsSuccess_isShown
methods.description: Verifies that news items are visible and scrollable when both topic and news data are successfully loaded.
